headline: 圖帕克命案審判開庭
context: 已故饒舌歌手圖帕克·夏庫爾（Tupac Shakur）的謀殺案，這週一在拉斯維加斯開庭審理。檢方指控被告杜安·戴維斯（Duane Davis）主導了 1996 年的槍擊案，動機是替姪子先前被圖帕克隨行人員毆打一事報復。辯方則說證據不夠紮實。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Prosecutors accuse Duane Davis of orchestrating 1996 shooting in retaliation for attack by rapper’s entourage The trial of a former gang leader accused of orchestrating the 1996 killing of rap star Tupac Shakur began in a Las Vegas courtroom on Monday, featuring testimony from a witness to the shooting and a former police officer. Duane “Keffe D” Davis is on trial for murder for his alleged role in the shooting of Shakur, who died after a drive-by shooting. Prosecutors allege Davis was the “on-the-ground, on-site commander of the effort to kill Tupac” and that he planned the shooting in retaliation for Shakur’s entourage attacking Davis’s nephew. sources.summary: Prosecutors said Duane Keith Davis participated in the shooting as an act of gang retaliation, while the defense pointed to what it described as a lack of hard evidence.

voice_text: 圖帕克命案，三十年後終於開庭審判。已故饒舌歌手圖帕克·夏庫爾的謀殺案，這週一在拉斯維加斯正式開審。檢方說，被告杜安·戴維斯策劃了 1996 年那場槍擊，動機是替姪子被圖帕克的隨行人員毆打一事報復。辯方則主張，檢方手上的證據並不紮實。
